description: This file defines a Flutter widget called PlayerCard that displays a mini profile of a cricket player, including avatar, name, jersey number, role, and statistics like runs and wickets. It uses external models and theme definitions, and is intended for UI rendering within a Flutter app.

classes.name: PlayerCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a brief profile summary of a player, including avatar, name, role, and stats. It handles tap gestures and styles the UI elements based on theme constants.

methods.name: initials
methods.description: Generates initials from the player's name, using the first character of the first and last parts of the name.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget layout, including avatar, name, role, and stats, with styling and tap handling.

methods.name: _stat
methods.description: Creates a widget that displays a specific statistic label and value.

methods.name: _roleLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for the player's role based on the enum.
